statement.ru: Вставные зубы Джорджа Вашингтона были деревянными.
statement.en: George Washington's false teeth were made of wood.

why: A myth: his dentures used hippo ivory, human and animal teeth, brass and gold, and no wood.

statement.ru: Пиявок и сегодня применяют в больницах.
statement.en: Leeches are still used in hospitals today.

why: Leech therapy returned in the 1970s for microsurgery such as reattaching fingers; the FDA classed leeches as a medical device in 2004.

statement.ru: В Европе толчёную мумию продавали в аптеках как лекарство.
statement.en: In Europe, ground-up mummy was sold in pharmacies as a medicine.

why: Powdered mummy (mummia) was sold by apothecaries as a cure-all; Merck still listed it in 1924.

statement.ru: Клятва Гиппократа начинается с клятвы богу Аполлону.
statement.en: The Hippocratic Oath begins by swearing by the god Apollo.

why: It opens: 'I swear by Apollo Healer, by Asclepius, by Hygieia, by Panacea...'

statement.ru: Пластырь Band-Aid придумали для раненых солдат на войне.
statement.en: The Band-Aid was invented for soldiers wounded in war.

why: Earle Dickson made it in 1920 for his wife, who often cut and burned herself while cooking.

statement.ru: Рентген назвал свои лучи «икс», потому что не понимал, что это такое.
statement.en: Röntgen called his rays 'X' because he didn't know what they were.

why: He used X to mark an unknown type of radiation, and objected when colleagues proposed 'Röntgen rays'.

statement.ru: Чёрную смерть — великую эпидемию чумы — вызывал вирус.
statement.en: The Black Death, the great plague epidemic, was caused by a virus.

why: It was the bacterium Yersinia pestis, confirmed by DNA from victims.

statement.ru: Хирург армии Наполеона придумал «летучие» кареты скорой помощи.
statement.en: A surgeon in Napoleon's army invented 'flying ambulances'.

why: Dominique Jean Larrey adapted fast horse-artillery carriages to carry the wounded off the battlefield.

statement.ru: Самая первая вакцина в истории была от кори.
statement.en: The very first vaccine in history was against measles.

why: The first vaccine was Jenner's smallpox vaccine (1796); the measles vaccine came in 1963.

statement.ru: Ополаскиватель «Листерин» назван в честь хирурга.
statement.en: Listerine mouthwash is named after a surgeon.

why: Named after Joseph Lister, pioneer of antiseptic surgery; it began as a surgical antiseptic.

statement.ru: Предок аспирина — вещество из коры дуба.
statement.en: Aspirin's ancestor is a substance from oak bark.

why: The precursor, salicin, comes from willow bark (Salix).

statement.ru: Флоренс Найтингейл носила в кармане ручную сову.
statement.en: Florence Nightingale carried a pet owl in her pocket.

why: She rescued a little owl in Athens, named it Athena and often carried it in her pocket.

statement.ru: Пенициллин открыли уже после Второй мировой войны.
statement.en: Penicillin was discovered after the Second World War.

why: Fleming discovered it in 1928; it was mass-produced during the war.

statement.ru: Врач открыл хлороформный наркоз, надышавшись хлороформом с коллегами.
statement.en: A doctor discovered chloroform anaesthesia by inhaling it with his colleagues.

why: In 1847 James Young Simpson and two assistants inhaled chloroform at his home, passed out and woke next morning.

statement.ru: Королева Виктория запретила обезболивание при родах.
statement.en: Queen Victoria banned pain relief in childbirth.

why: The opposite: in 1853 she gave birth to Leopold with chloroform, which made it respectable.

statement.ru: Первый публичный наркоз эфиром показали в Лондоне.
statement.en: The first public operation under ether was shown in London.

why: It was in Boston, at Massachusetts General Hospital's Ether Dome, in 1846.

statement.ru: Считалось, что прикосновение короля исцеляет от болезни.
statement.en: People believed a king's touch could cure a disease.

why: For centuries English and French kings touched sufferers of scrofula, 'the king's evil', to heal them.

statement.ru: Наполеон велел привить своих солдат от оспы.
statement.en: Napoleon had his soldiers vaccinated against smallpox.

why: Napoleon had his troops vaccinated and even freed English prisoners at Jenner's request.

statement.ru: Врача, призвавшего мыть руки, коллеги сразу признали героем.
statement.en: The doctor who urged handwashing was hailed a hero by colleagues at once.

why: Most doctors rejected or attacked Ignaz Semmelweis's idea; it was accepted only after his death.

statement.ru: Изобретатель первой вакцины выяснил, как кукушонок выталкивает яйца из гнезда.
statement.en: The inventor of the first vaccine found out how a cuckoo chick pushes eggs out of the nest.

why: Edward Jenner's 1788 cuckoo study got him into the Royal Society, years before his vaccine.

statement.ru: Вакцину от полиомиелита давали детям на кусочке сахара.
statement.en: Polio vaccine was given to children on a sugar cube.

why: Drops of the oral polio vaccine were put on sugar cubes in mass campaigns, e.g. Bonn in 1967.

statement.ru: Морфий назвали по фамилии химика, который его открыл.
statement.en: Morphine was named after the chemist who discovered it.

why: Friedrich Sertürner named it after Morpheus, the Greek god of dreams, because it brings sleep.

statement.ru: Создатели инсулина продали патент на него за миллион долларов.
statement.en: The discoverers of insulin sold its patent for a million dollars.

why: Banting, Best and Collip sold their patents to the University of Toronto for $1 each.

statement.ru: Лекарственный инсулин сегодня производят микробы.
statement.en: Medical insulin today is made by microbes.

why: Most clinical insulin is made by genetically modified E. coli bacteria or yeast.

statement.ru: Бактерии впервые увидели в микроскоп только в XX веке.
statement.en: Bacteria were first seen under a microscope only in the 20th century.

why: Antonie van Leeuwenhoek saw bacteria in the 1670s-1680s, including on his own teeth.

statement.ru: Когда-то врачи советовали астматикам курить особые сигареты.
statement.en: Doctors once advised asthma patients to smoke special cigarettes.

why: Stramonium asthma cigarettes were recommended by leading physicians and sold until the 1980s.

statement.ru: Название «малярия» означает «плохая вода».
statement.en: The name 'malaria' means 'bad water'.

why: It is Medieval Italian mala aria, 'bad air', from the miasma theory.

statement.ru: В XVII веке человеку перелили кровь ягнёнка.
statement.en: In the 17th century a person was given a transfusion of lamb's blood.

why: In 1667 Jean-Baptiste Denys transfused about twelve ounces of lamb blood into a 15-year-old boy.

statement.ru: Воду с радием продавали как полезное лекарство.
statement.en: Water with radium in it was sold as a healthy medicine.

why: Radithor, distilled water with radium, was sold as a patent medicine in the 1920s until deaths led to regulation.

statement.ru: На посохе Асклепия, символе медицины, обвились две змеи.
statement.en: On the Rod of Asclepius, the symbol of medicine, two snakes are coiled.

why: The Rod of Asclepius has one snake; the two-snake staff is Hermes' caduceus, often used by mistake.

statement.ru: Раньше цирюльники не только стригли, но и пускали кровь.
statement.en: Barbers once cut hair and also let blood.

why: Barber surgeons did bloodletting and minor surgery; the red-and-white pole is said to recall blood and bandages.

statement.ru: Первым медицинским градусникам хватало минуты, чтобы измерить температуру.
statement.en: The first medical thermometers took a minute to measure a temperature.

why: Mid-19th-century clinical thermometers were a foot long and took up to twenty minutes.

statement.ru: Знаменитый древнеримский врач Гален лечил гладиаторов.
statement.en: Galen, the famous doctor of Ancient Rome, treated gladiators.

why: For four years from about 157 AD he was physician to the gladiators of the High Priest of Asia in Pergamon.

statement.ru: Первый ребёнок «из пробирки» родился в США.
statement.en: The first 'test-tube baby' was born in the USA.

why: Louise Brown was born in 1978 in Oldham, England.

statement.ru: Белые халаты врачи носят уже тысячу лет.
statement.en: Doctors have worn white coats for a thousand years.

why: The white coat came into medicine in the late 1800s; before that doctors often wore black.

statement.ru: Лицо манекена для искусственного дыхания взяли с посмертной маски.
statement.en: The face of the CPR training dummy was taken from a death mask.

why: Resusci Anne's face is based on L'Inconnue de la Seine, the death mask of an unknown young woman from Paris.

statement.ru: Хирургические маски впервые надели во время «испанки» 1918 года.
statement.en: Surgical masks were first worn during the 1918 Spanish flu.

why: Surgeons such as Mikulicz-Radecki introduced them in Europe in the late 1890s.

statement.ru: Древние египтяне делали протезы пальцев ног из дерева и кожи.
statement.en: The ancient Egyptians made artificial toes out of wood and leather.

why: A worn wood-and-leather toe from about 950-710 BC was found on a mummy near Thebes.

statement.ru: Рентген стали применять в медицине лишь через полвека после открытия.
statement.en: X-rays were put to medical use only half a century after their discovery.

why: Discovered in November 1895, they were used clinically by January 1896.

statement.ru: Веками верили, что зубы портят крошечные черви.
statement.en: For centuries people believed tiny worms caused tooth decay.

why: The tooth-worm belief, found as far back as Babylon, lasted into the 18th century.

statement.ru: Лучшую плесень для пенициллина нашли на дыне с рынка.
statement.en: The best mould for making penicillin was found on a melon from a market.

why: The high-yield 'cantaloupe strain' came from a cantaloupe bought in a Peoria fruit market in 1943.
